'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|You've made a name for yourself, and I may have an assignment for someone like you. But before I do, I want to make sure you can tell who's an asset and who's a threat. It's simple, shoot the PMCs, but don't hurt my people. Understood?}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 7 PMC operatives without killing [[Scavs]], [[Scav Raiders]], [[Rogues]] or [[Bosses]]

==Rewards==
* +25,600 [[EXP]]
* [[Fence]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.04'''</font>
* 1,200 Euros
** 1,260 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 1,380 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Military flash drive]]
{{quote|Here's your reward.}}

==Failure Dialogue==
{{quote|Doesn't seem like you're trying to keep my people safe. Turns out you're more of a liability than a benefit. If you want to work with me, you have to prove your worth.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill 7 PMCs without killing any [[Scavs]], [[Scav Raiders]], [[Rogues]] or [[Bosses]].

'''<font color="red">Note:</font>''' Even after killing all PMCs, killing any of the above before you have left the raid and turned in the quest will result in a failure. You may die by any means and still complete the quest.
